name: Jury
overview: Scripture reveals that God established a system of communal leadership and judgment through appointed groups of elders, or juries, to share the burden of governance and decision-making. In Numbers 11, God commands Moses to gather seventy elders who are empowered by the Spirit to assist in leading the people, demonstrating the importance of collective spiritual and administrative responsibility. Additionally, Ruth 4 illustrates the practice of convening ten city elders to serve as a jury in legal matters, highlighting the role of elders as respected leaders entrusted with upholding justice within the community.
